import re
from datetime import datetime


def parse_nginx_log_line(line: str) -> dict:
    """
    Parse a single nginx access log line into a dictionary.

    Expected format (common nginx combined log format):
    <ip> - - [<date>] "<method> <url> <protocol>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<user_agent>"

    Returns a dict with keys: ip, date, method, url, protocol, status, bytes, referer, user_agent.
    """
    # Regex for the standard nginx combined log format
    pattern = re.compile(
        r'^(?P<ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)'
        r'\s+-\s+-\s+'
        r'\[(?P<date>[^\]]+)\]\s+'
        r'"(?P<method>[A-Z]+)\s+'
        r'(?P<url>[^\s]+)\s+'
        r'(?P<protocol>[A-Z/]+)"\s+'
        r'(?P<status>\d+)\s+'
        r'(?P<bytes>\d+)\s+'
        r'"(?P<referer>[^"]*)"\s+'
        r'"(?P<user_agent>[^"]*)"'
    )

    match = pattern.match(line)
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not parse log line: {line}")

    result = match.groupdict()

    # Convert date string to datetime object
    result["date"] = datetime.strptime(result["date"], "%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M:%S %z")

    # Convert status and bytes to integers
    result["status"] = int(result["status"])
    result["bytes"] = int(result["bytes"])

    return result
